problem.label: The hiring gap
problem.title: Technical validation is hard to scale when your team is already busy.
problem.description: Recruiters and founders often need a technical read before they can move a candidate forward, but internal engineers do not always have time to design interviews, run screens, and write usable feedback.
items: Slow technical feedback after promising screens.
Limited QA or manual testing evaluation capacity.

solution.label: How Lation helps
solution.title: A focused evaluation service for technical hiring decisions.
solution.description: Lation supports your hiring process with structured interview criteria, technical or QA screening, and concise reports that hiring teams can use without building a full platform workflow.
items: Define the role expectations before the interview.
Run or support the technical evaluation.
Deliver a practical report with strengths, risks, and next-step guidance.

services.label: Services
services.title: Technical evaluation support
services.subtitle: Focused services for teams that need technical interview coverage without adding CRM, scheduling, or internal operations tooling to this site.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: A simple lead-to-evaluation flow
howItWorks.subtitle: The landing page captures your hiring need. Lation follows up to scope the evaluation and run the right process.

steps.title: Share the role or candidate profile.
steps.description: Send the context, seniority, stack, and hiring goal.

steps.title: Lation defines the evaluation criteria.
steps.description: We align on what should be validated and how evidence will be collected.

steps.title: We conduct or support the screening.
steps.description: The evaluation can focus on engineering, QA, manual testing, or technical reasoning.

steps.title: You receive a structured report.
steps.description: The report gives your team clear feedback for the next hiring decision.

items.question: Is this a CRM or scheduling platform?
items.answer: No. This repository is only the public Lation landing page and protected lead capture flow.

items.question: Does Lation replace my hiring team?
items.answer: No. Lation provides technical evaluation support and structured reporting so your team can make better hiring decisions.

items.question: Can you evaluate QA candidates?
items.answer: Yes. Lation can support QA and manual testing candidate evaluation, including test design, bug reporting, and product judgment.
